newsitem.title: USA: Man crushed stealing iron safe in New York.
newsitem.headline: Man crushed stealing iron safe in New York.

text.p: A burglar trying to steal a 600-pound (272-kg) iron safe was crushed to death when it fell on him as he and an accomplice carried it down a flight of stairs, police said on Friday.
The body of the man was found on Thursday morning under the safe at the bottom of the staircase in a real estate and insurance office in Huntington, N.Y.
Police said they believed the dead man had an accomplice because officers had difficulty moving the safe, which contained only insurance forms.
